notes.title: Christmas in June
notes.content:
Hokay, so, here's the patch.

[list]
[*]The game will not crash at higher levels now.
[*]The leaderboard saves your score & rank, however, your name will not continue to display in the input field. You are able to change it if you like.
[/list]

[i]A request has been made for mini-bosses and other content. We will see those additions as we get closer to the month that Santa is strongest![/i] 

Sincerely,
Not Hephaestus
